content: WordPress-to-Next SEO migration failure modes: redirect map built from memory instead of crawl; missed attachment/category/tag/feed/paginated URLs; locale prefix (/en) invalidating legacy URLs; redirect chains; 308 vs 301 expectations; hand-built redirects dropping query strings and UTM attribution; host canonicalization and sitemap/hreflang gaps. Config redirects in Next preserve query strings; manual NextResponse.redirect requires copying search params.
